top_signals.title: Tanker attacks in Strait of Hormuz surge to wartime high as Iran tries to choke off oil exports
top_signals.summary: The escalating attacks are testing whether a rebound in crude oil exports from the Middle East can be sustained under high risk conditions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
